dedupe_keys.name: street network centrality and its scaling with urban population dataset

description: Street Network Centrality and Its Scaling with Urban Population Dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Renan Lucas Fagundes, Gabriel G. Piva (Universidade Federal de Lavras). This repository contains geospatial and network analysis outputs for Brazilian cities, with a focus on São Paulo. The data was generated through a reproducible workflow structured across three Jupyter notebooks. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
